name: Crop Life Science Ltd.
summary: Crop Life Science Ltd. is an Indian agrochemical company that specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of crop protection chemicals and plant health solutions. The company's product portfolio includes insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, weedicides, micro fertilizers, new generation organic bio-stimulants, bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides, plant growth regulators, and soil plant health products. Additionally, Crop Life Science Ltd. manufactures and supplies PET and HDPE bottles, along with caps and plugs, for packaging purposes. The company primarily targets the farming community, aiming to enhance crop yields and quality. With manufacturing facilities located in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, India, Crop Life Science Ltd. also engages in international trade, exporting its products to over 18 countries, including China, Brazil, and South Africa. The company adheres to quality and environmental management standards, holding ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2004 certifications.
